summary.en: The world's first Minesweeper implemented in pure CSS with no JavaScript.
summary.zh: 一行 JavaScript 都没有的扫雷，纯 CSS 实现的交互逻辑。

description.en: Classic Minesweeper rules, yet every interaction — revealing cells, flagging mines, even win/lose detection — runs on CSS Space Toggles wired to checkboxes and sibling selectors, with not a line of JavaScript.
description.zh: 用 Space Toggle 技巧配合 checkbox + 兄弟选择器完成翻格、标旗、胜负判定，玩法与经典扫雷一致。

howto.en: Click cells to reveal, right-click to flag mines.
howto.zh: 左键揭示格子，右键插旗标雷。

tip.en: A killer tech-flex marketing asset — pair the launch with a 'how does zero-JS Minesweeper work' write-up. The catch: fixed difficulty and no dynamic mine generation, so treat it as a novelty headline entry.
tip.zh: 极强的「技术流」营销素材：可以写一篇《零 JS 的扫雷是怎么做到的》配合上线。缺点是难度固定、无法动态生成雷区，适合当噱头条目。
